business_problem: Scania needed to replace fragmented legacy IT service systems, accelerate service rollout, and create a single digital service experience that could support both IT and HR workflows at global scale.
solution_summary: Scania first implemented ServiceNow IT Service Management using out-of-the-box capabilities to replace a homegrown portal and several disconnected service tools with a single platform for incidents, requests, and ordering. It then expanded that foundation with Employee Center and HR Service Delivery so IT and HR could deliver services from one portal, and added Employee Document Management to digitize HR records that had previously been stored on paper. The platform also automates hardware-order exchanges with suppliers so device information moves directly through workflows instead of via file-based handoffs, dramatically increasing installation throughput. By consolidating end-user, agent, supplier, and HR interactions on one platform, Scania gained shared visibility into subscriptions, assets, and employee requests while creating a reusable base for future onboarding, offboarding, and IT operations automation.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Runs the shared platform for incidents, requests, ordering, and IT service workflows.

solution_components.name: Employee Center
solution_components.role: Provides the one-stop portal used by end users, IT agents, and HR teams.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Extends the portal to HR enquiries and future onboarding and offboarding journeys.

solution_components.name: Employee Document Management
solution_components.role: Stores HR records digitally so documents can be accessed securely without paper handling.

data_flow: End users submit incidents, service requests, and HR enquiries through Employee Center, where IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery route the work to the right teams. Hardware-order workflows send supplier data directly instead of exchanging files, responses are processed back into the platform, and Employee Document Management stores HR documents so records stay accessible through the same digital service environment.
integration_points: Legacy access, ordering, incident, and asset systems
business_outcome: Scania cut wasted spend, multiplied device-throughput capacity, unified IT and HR service delivery in one portal, and improved collaboration and visibility across previously siloed teams.
metrics: $1.8M Saved per month by identifying missed subscription cancellations
